title: A Kai Tak simulator that runs in your browser
dek: No download: one page, real Hong Kong open data and the 1998 Runway 13 approach.
description: Fly Kai Tak runs in a web browser with nothing to install. How the simulator is put together: one page, Three.js and Hong Kong open data.
hero_alt: Kai Tak's Runway 13 seen from above Kowloon Bay, with Kowloon climbing to a green ridge and Lion Rock at its centre.
hero_caption: Runway 13 and the ridge behind Kowloon, built from open data.
card_title: A Kai Tak simulator in your browser

zh.title: 喺瀏覽器入面玩嘅啟德模擬器
zh.dek: 唔使下載：一個頁面、真實嘅香港開放數據，同 1998 年 13 跑道進場。
zh.description: Fly Kai Tak 喺瀏覽器入面就玩到，唔使安裝。睇吓呢個模擬器點樣砌成：一個頁面、Three.js 同香港開放數據。
zh.hero_alt: 喺九龍灣上空望啟德 13 跑道，九龍升上青綠色山脊，獅子山喺正中。
zh.hero_caption: 13 跑道同九龍後面嘅山脊，用開放數據砌成。
